info.name: Check which mentioned entities lack access

params.name: shareable_uuid
params.description: Shareable identifier (composite primary key or UUID)

params.name: user_uuids
params.description: UUIDs of mentioned users to check

params.name: team_uuids
params.description: UUIDs of mentioned teams to check

items.docs:
Reports which mentioned users and teams lack view access to a shareable and
whether the caller may grant them access. Powers the proactive
"grant access at mention" flow across every shareable type.
